data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Ghaidaa means 'guide' or 'pathfinder'. This name is derived from the root 'ghad' which means 'to guide'. In Islamic tradition, Ghaidaa is a name given to a woman who leads others towards the right path, and is often associated with the concept of guidance from Allah. The name Ghaidaa carries the meaning “Guide, Pathfinder” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ghaidaa usually hope their child will grow to embody guide, pathfinder and live with faith, good character and purpose.
